description: The oath of conquest binds a paladin to dominate the weak and prove superiority.

features.name: Conquest Strikes
features.description: Hit creatures more than once with weapon attacks that same turn deal extra damage.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: Creatures within aura that are frightened have reduced speed.

features.name: Scourge of the Faithless
features.description: Undead and fiends within 30 feet take extra damage.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: Resistance to all damage when using Channel Divinity.
